svg.title: Kalimba body
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. A 7-sided kalimba body, drawn by kalimba.rs. Cut it in 3mm Baltic birch; the box's outlines carry a 0.14mm kerf. Blue #0000ff engraves the rosette's interlace and is never cut; green #00ff00 cuts the rosette and the round hole, orange #ff8000 the optional stiffeners, then black #000000 frees the faces and walls.
